positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop multi-tier web applications using JavaScript frameworks (includes jQuery, Vue.js, MooTools), C# .NET, HTML5, CSS and related technologies in Visual Studios
• Database management on Microsoft SQL Server writing queries, stored procedures, and views
• Work within Agile development processes and best practices
• Communicate with business analysts and team members to
understand user stories and confirm business intent
• Deploying, automating, maintaining and managing cloud based
solutions
• Build, release and configuration management to production systems
• System troubleshooting and problem solving across platform and
application domains
• Recommending code improvements and perform routine software
maintenance

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
● 	Design and implement dynamic web content and web server applications using Outsystems platform
● 	Develop front-end via HTML, CSS, jQuery, and JavaScript
● 	Integrate web APIs and SOAP/REST web services within applications
● 	Perform data management by writing Microsoft SQL Server and MySQL queries and procedures
● 	Communicate directly with applicable departments to ensure adequate understanding of business processes and requirements, and deliver applications in timely manner
● 	Agile SCRUM Methodology, Microsoft Visual Studio C#, AJAX, Cordova Plugins

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
Student Assistant - USF IT

● Created and maintained pages in asp .NET for Work Order System
● Design and implementation of dynamic data displays for Building Automation System
● Generated RDLC reports using SQL Server Data Tool
● Utilized PL/SQL to access Oracle databases and query data
● Generated graphical to monitor universities SCADA HVAC Systems
● Worked in a team to generate floor plans and inspect university buildings for Integrated Facilities Information System
